## How the Inito Fertility Monitor Works

The Inito fertility monitor measures four hormones from a single urine sample. This article explains the science behind each measurement.

### The four hormones

- **Estrogen (E3G)** rises in the follicular phase as a follicle matures.
- **LH** surges roughly 24–36 hours before ovulation.
- **PdG** rises after ovulation, confirming an egg was released.
- **FSH** indicates how hard the body is working to recruit a follicle.

### How the reader takes a measurement

Insert the test strip into the reader, attach it to your phone, and the app displays all four hormone levels on one chart.

### Why four hormones matter

Most ovulation tests measure LH alone. LH predicts ovulation but cannot confirm it. Measuring PdG alongside LH closes that gap, which is why a four-hormone panel gives a fuller picture of the cycle than a single-hormone strip.

### Understanding your chart

The app plots each hormone across the cycle. A typical ovulatory pattern shows estrogen rising, an LH peak, then a sustained PdG rise in the following days.

### Accuracy

The device is FDA-registered and quantifies hormone concentrations rather than returning a binary positive or negative.

### Getting started

Order a reader and a monthly strip pack. Testing usually begins on day 6 of the cycle.
